system.description: Spending a Willpower Trait and winning a Mental Challenge against a spirit compels it to obey a command, so long as the command doesn't endanger it or violate its ethics. Spending a second Willpower Trait and winning another Mental Challenge can force it into a self-endangering or unethical act, though the spirit will likely seek revenge later, or may simply pretend to comply. Losing a challenge against a spirit while using this power risks provoking a retaliatory attack.
